# Platform reference

Every class in `assets/scripts/platform/`, from its doc comments. The overview is in [README.md](README.md).

- [RunEnvironment](#runenvironment)

## RunEnvironment

`res://assets/scripts/platform/RunEnvironment.gd`, extends [`RefCounted`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_refcounted.html)

Facts about where this run of the game is, asked in one place. So far: whether it has a display.

Use:

```gdscript
if RunEnvironment.is_headless(): ...        # nothing is drawn: a test, or a dedicated server (Godot started with --headless)
if not RunEnvironment.runs_visuals(): ...   # a visual-only part (a toy figure, a floating sword) has nothing to do
```

A test that checks visual parts while running headless turns `visuals_without_display` on.

### Settings and properties

- `visuals_without_display: bool` = `false`

### Functions

- `is_headless() -> bool` *(static)*: True when nothing is drawn: Godot was started headless, as tests and dedicated servers are.
- `runs_visuals() -> bool` *(static)*: True if visual-only parts should run: there's a display, or visuals_without_display is on.
